verdict.rationale: My DOR is an online tax-filing and licensing portal, and a portal like that could plausibly offer AI insights, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data. The Business Licensing Wizard's 'helpful tips' and the automatic Small Business Credit calculation are rule-based features, not AI analysis, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
